$comment: pekwm's default keybinds: the Global section of etc/pekwm/keys in nixpkgs' pekwm (nixos-26.05), copied to ~/.pekwm/keys on first start (the MoveResize, InputDialog and Menu sections are modal and left out). The action is the Actions string; a bind inside a Chain is written as its Chain block, its accel is the chain's first combo and the label has the whole sequence. Regenerate with scripts/keybinds/extract-x11-wms.py.
